User.title: User
User.description: Registered application user with simplified 2-tier role access (admin or user).

role.description: Assigned access role: admin or user

deviceInfo.description: Device name or client user-agent summary

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account was created

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User feedback, suggestions, reviews, and bug reports with admin replies.

userId.description: UID of user who submitted feedback

adminReply.description: Admin response reply message to user

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when feedback was sent

BroadcastNotification.title: BroadcastNotification
BroadcastNotification.description: System-wide notification broadcast by Admin to all users announcing new features and updates.

badge.description: Optional pill tag (e.g. New, Release, Pro)

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL for the feature alert

NewsPost.title: NewsPost
NewsPost.description: News article or release blog post authored and published by the Admin.

imageUrl.description: Web URL (Chrome link) or uploaded image data URL for article banner

imageCaption.description: Optional caption or alt text for the image

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles with 2-role system (admin or user) and lastLoginAt timestamps.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: User feedback tickets and Admin replies.

/broadcast_notifications/{notificationId.description: Broadcast notifications for new features sent by Admin to all users.

/news_posts/{postId}.description: News and blog posts published by Admin for users to read.
